Mark tag produces highlighted output

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>This is <mark>highlighted text</mark> in a sentence.</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
